svg.title: Tactical Synthesis, Selection, and Execution
svg.desc: Offline, Grok 4.7 proposes candidate tactics. Each candidate is evaluated with a fixed policy against a scripted attack-move baseline under the same seed; passing tactics are published as a cookbook and executable policy. Online, Jev selects from the validated menu and the executor emits unit-level micro-actions.
svg.text: A OFFLINE TACTIC CONSTRUCTION AND SCREENING
Evaluate each tactic on paired seeds
Compare with a fixed combat policy
Release rule: map-independent physical conditions; only validated tactics enter the menu.
B ONLINE SELECTION AND UNIT-LEVEL EXECUTION
A single eligible option runs directly
Maps tactic and state to unit actions
From candidate tactic generation and paired-seed validation to online selection and execution.
Only validated tactics enter the menu. Jev selects a tactic; deterministic code performs the unit-level control.
Combat screenshot: SMAC+ “Offense near” scenario, OSI Lab KAIST (github.com/osilab-kaist/smac_exp), cropped.
